caption: The drawing is a monochrome, sepia-toned map featuring the western coastline of California, marked by a prominent dark curving line that outlines the landmass bordering the Pacific Ocean labeled as "Océano Pacífico". Along this coastline, various mission names are inscribed, each with a small icon of a church building next to them. In the upper right corner, there are illustrations of two human figures: one is an armored soldier holding a spear, and the other is a friar holding a cross. Between them, there is an ornate coat of arms featuring heraldic symbols. The word "California" is drawn prominently at the top in a stylized script. A compass rose appears in the lower left section, next to a detailed depiction of a galleon sailing on the ocean waves. Additional decorative script and flourishes are included, and the background is left mostly blank, focusing the attention on the coastal line, icons, and ornamentation.
title: Map
